in_sanskrit.name: महाकाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahat means great and Kala means time. So Mahakal means Great Time or Great Age.

in_hindi.name: महाकाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mahat means big and Kala means time. So Mahakal means Big Time or Large Age.

in_tamil.name: மகாகல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Maham means great and Kalam means time. So Mahakal means Great Time or Great Age.

in_telugu.name: మహాకాల
in_telugu.long_meaning: Maham means great and Kala means time. So Mahakal means Great Time or Large Age.

in_marathi.name: Mahakal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahakal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahakal refers to Shiva in his aspect as the lord of time. He is the destroyer of all things and is also responsible for the creation and preservation of the universe. This name signifies power, strength, and the passage of time.

in_bengali.name: Mahakal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Great Time
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mahakal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mahakal refers to Shiva in his aspect as the lord of time. He is the destroyer of all things and is also responsible for the creation and preservation of the universe. This name signifies power, strength, and the passage of time.
